title: 第7章 炼气一层-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王建新蹲在门口把饼吃完，抹了抹嘴，心里开始盘算。

    今天不去巡边了。

    隔段时间去看看就行了，用不着天天往那儿跑。那道铁丝网立在那儿又不是纸糊的，不会自己跑了。真要是跑过来人，附近就他这有人，真要能抓个蒙古人，还能立功呢。

    现在最重要的是抓紧修炼。

    如果达到炼气一层，他就可以跨过边界去蒙古国那边看看了。来草原这么久，日子过得清汤寡水的，啥也没有。白面、盐、几块奶疙瘩，翻来覆去就这几样东西。空间里倒是种了菜，但菜又不能当肉吃。

    他馋肉了。

    不光是馋肉。蒙古国那边有没有什么物资能弄回来？那边的情况怎么样？他心里没底，得先过去看看，摸清楚再说。

    每天就这日子，放羊、种菜、巡逻、也不是个事啊。

    王建新站起来，把碗收了，回到土坯房里。

    接下来的日子，他定了条规矩：隔几天巡一次边，剩下的时间全用来修炼。

    早上起来，进空间洗漱，然后盘腿坐在河边修炼。饿了就出来做饭吃，吃完接着练。困了就睡，醒了就练。

    空间里的灵气比较充足，尤其是河边那块地方，坐着坐着就能感觉到灵气往身上扑。那一丝灵气在他体内慢慢运转，一圈一圈地转，每转一圈就壮大一点点。

    日子过得快，不知不觉就过去了一个月。

    这一个月里，王建新每隔三四天出去巡一次边。骑着马沿着铁丝网走一圈，看看有没有破洞，有没有人越界的痕迹。每次都是啥也没有，除了草还是草，连个鬼影都看不见。

    让他觉得有意思的是，他一直没发现蒙古国那边的巡边军人。

    按说边界两边都应该有人巡逻才对。他在这边骑着马走，那边也应该有人骑着马走。可他来这儿一个多月了，对面一个人也没见着。

    也不知道是这个地方太偏了，还是什么原因。

    反正是来了这么长时间，什么人也没见着。

    王建新觉得奇怪，但也没多想。没人更好，省得麻烦。

    这天，王建新像往常一样，进了空间，盘腿坐在河边。

    他闭着眼睛，引导体内那股灵气慢慢运转。练了一个月，那股气已经从一根蛛丝变成了一根筷子那么粗，在小腹位置稳稳当当的，像一团温水似的。

    灵气沿着脊椎往上走，走到头顶的时候，突然卡住了。

    王建新皱了皱眉，没有硬冲，而是慢慢加力，一点一点地往前推。

    卡在头顶的那道关口像一扇门，怎么也推不开。他没有着急，耐心地引导灵气一次次地冲击。

    一次，两次，三次……
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Jianxin squatted at the door and finished the cake, wiped his mouth, and began to make plans in his mind.

I won’t go on patrol today.

It’s enough to check it out every once in a while, there’s no need to run there every day.The barbed wire fence standing there is not paper and will not run away on its own.If someone really comes running, he is the only one nearby. If he really can catch a Mongolian, he can still perform meritorious service.

The most important thing now is to practice hard.

If he reaches the first level of Qi Refining, he can cross the border and visit Mongolia.I have been in the grassland for so long, and my life has been empty and empty, with nothing.White flour, salt, a few milk lumps, just these things.There are vegetables planted in the space, but the vegetables cannot be eaten as meat.

He is hungry for meat.

It’s not just about eating meat.Are there any supplies that can be obtained from Mongolia?What's the situation like over there?He didn't know what was going on, so he had to go and take a look first and find out more before talking.

Every day is just a day, herding sheep, growing vegetables, and patrolling, it’s not a big deal.

Wang Jianxin stood up, put away the bowl, and returned to the adobe house.

In the days that followed, he made a rule: patrol the border every few days, and spend the rest of the time practicing.

Get up in the morning, go into the space to wash up, and then sit cross-legged by the river to practice.When I'm hungry, I go out to cook and eat, and then continue practicing after eating.Go to sleep when you feel sleepy and practice when you wake up.

The spiritual energy in the space is relatively abundant, especially the area by the river. You can feel the spiritual energy rushing towards you while sitting.That trace of spiritual energy slowly circulated in his body, turning around and around, growing a little stronger with each turn.

The days passed quickly, and a month passed before I knew it.

In this month, Wang Jianxin went out to patrol the border every three or four days.Ride a horse and walk along the barbed wire fence to see if there are any holes or signs of someone crossing the line.Every time there was nothing, just grass, not even a ghost.

What’s interesting to him is that he has never found the border patrol soldiers on the Mongolian side.

Normally, there should be patrols on both sides of the border.He is riding a horse here, and someone should be riding a horse over there.But he has been here for more than a month and has not seen anyone across the street.

I don’t know if it’s because this place is too remote or what the reason is.

Anyway, I’ve been here for so long and haven’t seen anyone.

Wang Jianxin felt strange, but didn’t think much about it.No one is better, save yourself the trouble.

On this day, Wang Jianxin entered the space and sat cross-legged by the river as usual.

He closed his eyes and guided the spiritual energy in his body to circulate slowly.After practicing for a month, the Qi has changed from a spider silk to a chopstick thickness, and it is stable in the lower abdomen, like a ball of warm water.

The spiritual energy went up along the spine, and when it reached the top of the head, it suddenly got stuck.

Wang Jianxin frowned and did not charge hard. Instead, he slowly increased his strength and pushed forward bit by bit.

The gate stuck above my head is like a door that cannot be pushed open.He was not in a hurry and patiently guided the spiritual energy to strike again and again.

Once, twice, three times...
